mapper.select: SELECT A.JOB_ID /* JOB일련번호 */ , A.JOB_NM /* JOB명(dstone-batch @AutoRegJob명과 일치) */ , A.SERVER_ID /* 대상 배치서버ID */ , B.SERVER_NM /* 대상 배치서버명 */ , A.DESCRIPTION /* 설명 */ , A.CRON_EXPRESSION /* CRON표현식 */ , A.SCHEDULE_USE_YN /* 자동스케줄 사용여부 */ , A.OWNER_NM /* 담당자 */ , A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , A.REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , A.UPDATE_DT /* 수정일시 */ FROM TB_BATCH_JOB A INNER JOIN TB_BATCH_SERVER B ON A.SERVER_ID = B.SERVER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.SERVER_ID = #{SERVER_ID} AND A.JOB_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{JOB_NM}, '%') AND A.USE_YN = #{USE_YN} ORDER BY A.JOB_ID DESC

SELECT A.JOB_ID , A.JOB_NM , A.SERVER_ID , A.CRON_EXPRESSION , A.SCHEDULE_USE_YN , A.USE_YN FROM TB_BATCH_JOB A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.SCHEDULE_USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.CRON_EXPRESSION IS NOT NULL
SELECT A.JOB_ID , A.JOB_NM , A.SERVER_ID , A.DESCRIPTION , A.CRON_EXPRESSION , A.SCHEDULE_USE_YN , A.OWNER_NM , A.USE_YN , A.REG_DT , A.UPDATE_DT FROM TB_BATCH_JOB A WHERE 1=1 AND A.JOB_ID = #{jobId}
